reconciliation.explanation: 269 + 64 = 333 sums every known input and output report, including the unfinished attempt that reported 9 output tokens and no input. reportedBillableTokens is 324 because the internal complete-pair metric adds input and output only when an attempt reported both. 333 - 9 = 324. Those 9 tokens are excluded from that metric only. This run does not decide whether a vendor would bill them. The attempt reported no cost, so its provider-reported cost stays unknown. Cache and reasoning stay inside the reported input and output totals and are not added again.

currency.unit: USD-shaped provider-reported number from the synthetic fixture

definitions.attempt: One provider turn on a governed task tree.
definitions.snapshot: turnTokenUsage replaces the same turn. Input includes cache. Output includes reasoning.
definitions.incremental: A later incremental report adds to that turn.
definitions.missing: Unknown stays null. It is not stored or displayed as zero.
definitions.cost: Provider-reported cost only. No price table.
definitions.acceptance: Human accept of the current contract revision. Provider completion is not acceptance.
definitions.perAccepted: All cohort consumption divided by accepted tasks. Undefined when none are accepted.
definitions.partial: Any missing usage category or cost makes the total partial.
